```text
# Example: pnpm typecheck
```

Manual or browser evidence, if applicable / 人工或浏览器证据（如适用）：

## Security, privacy, and data / 安全、隐私与数据

- [ ] No credential, token, private document, HR/customer data, absolute user
      path, or session data is included.
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots are synthetic/minimal and safe to redistribute.
- [ ] Session isolation, path containment, quotas, and parser limits are not
      weakened, or the impact is explained above.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details were reported privately under `SECURITY.md`.

## License and provenance / 许可与来源

- [ ] Existing upstream copyright and MIT notices remain intact.
- [ ] Copied/adapted code or assets have source and license recorded.
- [ ] `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `assets/README.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the MIT License.

## Contributor checklist / 贡献者检查

- [ ] The change is focused and unrelated refactors are excluded.
- [ ] Tests/documentation cover the changed contract.
- [ ] Generated `lib/` output matches `src/` where applicable.
- [ ] Every commit includes my DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
